title: Assistance and Compensation for Farmers Affected by expansion of Tengah Airbase
what_it_is: Assistance and Compensation for Farmers Affected by expansion of Tengah Airbase

sections.label: Support for affected farm owners
sections.summary: Officers will contact affected owners, assist with land acquisition, and advise on relocation, business development and technology adoption.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Singapore Land Authority officers have already contacted the affected owners and will assist them through the land acquisition process.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Agri-Food and Veterinary Authority of Singapore (AVA) and the National Parks Board (NParks) will also provide support for those who wish to continue their businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There will be specific officers assigned to each establishment.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: They will advise owners on relocation options, business development and technology adoption.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For instance, owners can apply for AVA's Agriculture Productivity Fund and NParks' Landscape Productivity Grant.
